summary: Layer 1B expansion for the data-center electrical power-delivery node finds one high-attention reference leader and three more underfollowed US-listed direct/second-order names. The strongest direct public evidence in this pass is Powell Industries, where management explicitly ties medium-voltage switchgear demand, record backlog, and a post-quarter $400M-plus data-center award to AI/data-center power needs. IES Holdings is a direct electrical and infrastructure installer/manufacturer with data-center-driven backlog and revenue mix, but requires customer and margin-quality verification. Atkore is a second-order electrical raceway/cable-management supplier to commercial, industrial, and data-center construction, with evidence that data centers are a demand pocket but less pure exposure. Preformed Line Products is a lower-attention grid/conductor/substation hardware supplier whose link is more grid-upgrade and interconnection-adjacent than data-center-specific, so it enters as a hypothesis rather than a proven AI data-center beneficiary.
